newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jet Services distributes 10 mln flu vaccine doses.
newsitem.headline: Jet Services distributes 10 mln flu vaccine doses.

text.p: French express distribution company Jet Services said on Thursday it had distributed ten million flu vaccine doses to 10,000 pharmacies throughout France between September 23 and 26.
The value of the contract was not immediately available.
The vaccines were stored in temperature-controlled facilties at Jet Services' 52 distribution depots throughout France before being shipped, the company added.
Jet Services delivered the flu vaccine shipments on behalf of French pharmaceuticals companies Pasteur-Merieux and Sanofi.
Jet Services' airline subsidiary Air Jet operates BAe 146QC (quick change) freighter rotations linking Paris, Marseille, Toulouse,Strasbourg, Montpellier and Rennes.
